name: hackorbit-website
description: Hack Orbit organization website — HTML/CSS/Vanilla JS + Vercel Serverless Functions

scripts.build: node frontend/build.js && node seo/sitemap-generate.js > sitemap.xml && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src='sitemap.xml'; const dest=path.join('frontend','build-output','sitemap.xml'); if (fs.existsSync(src)) { fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest), { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync(src, dest); }"
